performance.verdict: No paid activity; 5 overdue milestones are the real emergency.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages all missed July 31 deadline — 37 days overdue with no completion event recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting both missed August 1 — 35 days overdue; $0 spend across all 28 days confirms campaigns never went live.
Spend efficiency is unmeasurable: $0 spend, 0 leads, 0 CPL over the full 45-day series — no paid channel has ever activated for this client.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for the last 6 consecutive days (Sep 1–5), down from a prior 45-day average of ~3.2 actions/day — organic intake has also gone dark.
GHL shows 36 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — with 109 contacts and no ad traffic, the source and quality of these opps is unaccounted for.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no ad spend should activate until stack test passes and LSA verification is submitted.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are confirmed overdue as of 2026-09-06: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages (all due July 31), and Ads Launch + Meta Retargeting Launch (both due August 1). Success check: all 5 items show a completed event in the system by 2026-09-13.
